label: ACCEPT
reason: API hooks in hooks/polar (checkout_links.ts, orders.ts, subscriptions.ts) all take the typed client from usePolarClient(), and nothing in .oxlintrc.json enforces it; useDeleteUser in users.ts hand-rolls fetch with its own base URL, Bearer header and Polar-Version even though v1.ts types DELETE /v1/users/me, which is exactly what the warning should catch. The co-located pure helpers in metrics.ts and the cache-only usePayout in finance.ts are legit, but they are only 3 of 38 members, so I hesitated with WRONG mixed_group and chose ACCEPT.
defects: clients/apps/app/hooks/polar/users.ts:6 useDeleteUser bypasses usePolarClient() with a raw fetch and manual auth headers although the typed client supports DELETE /v1/users/me
